meta.title_plain: How a 1984 movie villain got his own hit show 34 years later
meta.teaser: Cobra Kai brought The Karate Kid back by telling Johnny Lawrence's side.

page.title: How a 1984 movie villain got his own hit show 34 years later
page.bigIdea: Cobra Kai took the bad guy from The Karate Kid and asked a new question. What if every story has another side?

cards.title: Back to the All-Valley
cards.front: In 1984, Daniel beat Johnny at the All-Valley Karate Tournament.
cards.back: Cobra Kai starts 33 years later, in 2017. Johnny is down on his luck. Daniel runs a big car business.
cards.tryit: Think of a match you lost. Write one thing you'd do differently in a rematch.

cards.title: The villain becomes the hero
cards.front: The show tells the story from Johnny's side.
cards.back: It treats Johnny's story as a comeback, not just a bad guy's. Actor William Zabka had long said Johnny was the real hero.
cards.tryit: Pick a villain from One Piece or a game. Write two sentences from their point of view.

cards.title: A homemade pitch trailer
cards.front: In 2017, three writers wanted to bring the story back.
cards.back: Josh Heald, Jon Hurwitz and Hayden Schlossberg made a mock trailer from old footage. They pitched it to several streaming companies.
cards.tryit: Make a 30-second 'trailer' on your phone for a game or show idea you have.

cards.title: From YouTube to Netflix
cards.front: The show first appeared on YouTube Red on May 2, 2018.
cards.back: That was 34 years after the movie. In 2020 it moved to Netflix and quickly became one of its most-watched shows.
cards.tryit: Ask Dad which old movie he'd love to see come back as a show.

cards.title: A six-season journey
cards.front: Cobra Kai ran for six seasons and 65 episodes.
cards.back: The last episodes came out on February 13, 2025. It was mostly filmed in Atlanta, Georgia, not California where it's set.
cards.tryit: Plan a three-part story: write one line for the beginning, middle and end.

words.d: A school or training hall where people learn martial arts like karate.

quiz.q: Whose side of the story does Cobra Kai mostly tell?
quiz.hint: Think about the boy who lost the 1984 final.
quiz.why: The show retells the rivalry as Johnny's comeback story.

quiz.q: How did the creators first pitch the show?
opts: With a mock trailer from old footage
quiz.hint: Look at card 3. It was something you watch.
quiz.why: They cut together old footage of the actors into a fake trailer to sell the idea.

quiz.q: Where did Cobra Kai first come out in 2018?
quiz.hint: It only moved to its famous home two years later.
quiz.why: It started on YouTube Red, then moved to Netflix in 2020.

quiz.q: Why does the show say '34 years later'?
quiz.hint: Do the maths between the movie year and the show's first year.
quiz.why: The movie came out in 1984 and the show premiered in 2018: 2018 minus 1984 is 34.

page.think: Cobra Kai shows that a 'villain' can have his own reasons. Think of a tennis rival or a game opponent. What might the match look like from their side?
